FinFilings AI - Phase 1 validation output (raw)
=================================================
Captured 2026-10-30 after the build-manager review fixes. Each section is the
command as run from the repository root, followed by its unedited output.
Run individually (the agent shell could not redirect output to files), and
copied verbatim into this file.

CAVEAT: every index-level test indexes deterministic SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURES
(1,000 generated chunks, 61-206 tokens each, ~720-word Zipf vocabulary). The
compression ratio, segment counts, and retrieval checks below are fixture
results. They are not SEC/EDGAR corpus measurements and must not be quoted
as real retrieval quality or production performance.

amd64
v1
1

CPU (from the benchmark header): AMD Ryzen 7 5800H with Radeon Graphics, 16 logical CPUs (benchmark suffix -16)
